column3: CI-ADR-FASTPATH-1: runs the changes filter step of ci.yml and the adr-numbers step conditions; reads both ledgers (a new row whose proving test reads ADR text must turn it red) and the guard-inputs map. ADR text and changelog.d are not inputs: it checks readers against a synthetic new ADR and the tracked file list, and an ADR edit cannot change a map glob. codeql.yml and check-closures.sh are fake changed-file entries fed to the filter, not read
